answer: Each identity files a behavior fingerprint in a nebula registry: a 14-beat sonnet, plus a 70-credit bond. Each epoch an auditor replays a beat; a missing beat, copied cadence, or shared key freezes the bond. First 45, each next 7 more: 1,000 fakes pay 3,541,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented fingerprints fail: a borrowed cadence lacks its own violet mark, cannot replay them. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep their bond.
